text:
Alex K: NexaCorp autopay failing for multiple invoices — batch of declines at ~15:27 UTC, error = 'card_declined (issuer)'. Customer reports latest attempts show 3DS popup spinning then timeout.
Maria T: Can you drop the first request id + payload? I want to check routing and 3DS flow.
Alex K: Ticket #4567 — request_id=rc_0a9f3... payload: `{"merchant_id":"nexa-7","amount":1200,"po_number":"PO-998"}`
Sam H: I pulled the gateway logs — acs responses show `HTTP 504` from ACS for many of these. Also issuer returned `insufficient_funds` for ~40%.
Lydia (payments): @Sam H can you paste sample gateway txn id and ACS trace? I'll check bank decline codes and velocity checks.
Sam H: Txn ids: `txn_7890abc`, `txn_7890def`. ACS trace snippet:
```
ACS_CONNECT timeout (30s)
Status: 504
ACS-Error: session_timeout
KV: challenge_flow=redirect
```
Jordan P: Noticing a spike in fraud heuristics for that merchant — velocity + BIN match anomalies. Could be false positive from new BIN block rule we rolled yesterday.
Maria T: Could be two issues — (1) ACS timeouts causing fallback to fallback path -> issuer soft decline, (2) new BIN rule bumping score -> forced decline. We need repro steps.
Alex K: Repro steps I ran:
1) Create test invoice with same PO and card BIN (ends 4242)
2) Call /v1/payments/charge with `simulate_3ds_redirect=true`
3) Observe browser 3DS iframe -> spinner -> eventually `checkout_error: acs_timeout`

Sam H: Quick check: run `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/payments/txn/txn_7890abc/logs` and look for `acs=504`. Also see `fraud_score` in payload.
Lydia (payments): I pulled the bank codes — issuer returned `05` (do not honor) and `51` (insufficient funds) for different cards. I'll open dispute with issuing partner and temp adjust BIN rule for that merchant.
Alex K: Customer wants ETA — they have 120 invoices queued. Any temporary mitigation? 
Jordan P: Can enable fallback to legacy BIN whitelist for nexacorp only, and increase ACS timeout to 45s as a canary. I'll prepare a canary config and rollout to prod region `us-west-2`.
Maria T: Also add a canary rollback in case we see higher fraud false positives. @ops-bot please create incident-bridge and runbook link.
ops-bot: Created bridge `#incident-4567` and ran runbook `payments/3ds-acs-timeout`. Pager notified oncall.
Sam H: I've posted a prod log join command: `kubectl logs -l app=payments -c acs-proxy -n prod --since=1h | grep txn_7890abc`
Lydia (payments): I'll request issuer reevaluation and temp credit hold for affected invoices. Keeping customer updated.
Alex K: Thanks — I'll message NexaCorp with ETA ~2 hours and the mitigation steps.
Maria T: Keep this thread for notes, move actionable tasks to Jira.
